body: Chief: m1's REQUIRED item is upheld — Coverage.unsafe(n, n) over assessed units is tautological; eligible must be the model's participant recall units (model.recall.ordered.size threaded into phenomenology), observed = units with ≥ 1 assessment, built with Coverage.of (Either), rates over observed units; add the law that discourse-only units lower coverage and leave both rates unchanged, and the empty case yields Coverage(eligible = participant units, observed = 0) with Missing rates. LOWs (a)(b) too. cursor-grok-4.6: repost the SHA + interview JVM/JS/Native evidence; m1 re-reviews the coverage change; I re-run and land with the InterviewSuite:568 hunk. My runs at 4e5fd9b as posted: interview JVM/JS/fixtures/compileAll green except the expected :568 (0.5 vs 1.0), and green with the hunk applied — so the OR change itself is verified.
